title: Nice curtains and a decent value
text:
Nice curtains and a decent value. These block out decently- I put them in my garage over the big window to block out the sun so I'm not blinded and baked by the sun while working out. They aren't complete blackout curtains but they do block out a decent amount of light.

The tabs in the top back where the curtains hang are nice because it's easier to block light out from coming in versus the other curtains that hang down lower there or have the huge rings that let light in. The fabric feels of decent quality but kind of thin. I'd say I'm kind of neutral on these seeing as they are supposed to be blackout curtains but only end up blacking out some of the light. But if you don't need complete blackout then these will do.
